meta.title: PRC Content Transformer Suite Demo
meta.description: One-click demo of prc-markdown-for-agents: serve WordPress posts as Markdown via .md and /markdown URLs
meta.author: pewresearch

steps.command: wp plugin activate prc-icon-library prc-markdown-for-agents markdown-comment-block

wp post create --post_type=post --post_name=demo-article --post_title='Demo Article: AI Markdown Endpoint' --post_status=publish --post_content='

This article is served as Markdown via the /markdown and .md URL endpoints provided by the prc-markdown-for-agents plugin.

How it works

Append /markdown to any post URL to receive the full article content as clean Markdown — including YAML front matter with metadata. AI agents and crawlers can consume this directly without parsing HTML.

  • Visit /demo-article/markdown for Markdown output
  • Visit /demo-article.md for the same output
  • Visit /llms.txt for the site-level AI index

The response includes a Content-Type: text/markdown header and a YAML front matter block with the post title, author, date, and canonical URL.
